name: dify-for-vscode
description: A Dify-powered VS Code agent platform with task-aware context management, presentation design, Office document generation, coding tools, browser automation, MCP, semantic vector search and CrewAI-inspired multi-agent orchestration.

difyForVscode.baseUrl.description: Dify API base URL. Use the /v1 base, not /v1/chat-messages.

difyForVscode.yoloMode.description: Automatically approve mutating local tools, browser actions, shell commands, Office writes and potentially mutating MCP tools.

difyForVscode.maxAgentSteps.description: Maximum Dify/tool loop steps for one top-level request.

difyForVscode.contextManagerEnabled.description: Compact older completed tasks before sending messages to Dify while preserving recent detailed task context and the visible chat transcript.

difyForVscode.contextRecentTasks.description: Number of recent top-level tasks kept with detailed execution context. Older tasks are summarized.

difyForVscode.contextMaxChars.description: Approximate maximum serialized message characters sent to Dify after context compaction.

difyForVscode.contextToolResultMaxChars.description: Maximum characters retained for one tool result in outbound model context.

difyForVscode.contextStoredToolResultMax.description: Maximum tool-result characters retained in compacted workspace execution history.

difyForVscode.contextSummaryMaxChars.description: Maximum characters reserved for accumulated summaries of older completed tasks.

difyForVscode.checkUpdatesOnStartup.description: Check GitHub Releases after extension startup.

difyForVscode.browserChannel.description: Browser channel used by Playwright Core. Auto tries installed Edge/Chrome first.

difyForVscode.browserIgnoreHTTPSErrors.description: Ignore HTTPS certificate errors in the managed browser context.

difyForVscode.mcpServers.description: MCP server map. Each entry supports enabled, transport (stdio/http/sse), command/args/env or url/headers, plus timeout fields. Header/env strings support ${env:NAME}.

difyForVscode.mcpBridgeEnabled.description: Automatically start the local VS Code MCP bridge server.

difyForVscode.mcpBridgeRequireToken.description: Require a generated bearer token for the local MCP bridge.

difyForVscode.semanticEmbeddingBaseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible embeddings base URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1. Empty uses local code-aware hash vectors.

difyForVscode.semanticEmbeddingModel.description: Embedding model name, e.g. nomic-embed-text or text-embedding-3-small.

difyForVscode.semanticIndexMaxFiles.description: Maximum files indexed in a semantic index build.

difyForVscode.semanticChunkOverlapChars.description: Approximate character overlap between semantic chunks.

difyForVscode.crewTaskMaxSteps.description: Default maximum steps for each Crew sub-agent task.

difyForVscode.crewMaxParallelTasks.description: Maximum concurrently executing async Crew tasks. Mutating tool calls are serialized.

difyForVscode.crewMaxReviewCycles.description: Maximum automatic implementation fix -> reviewer recheck cycles after a reviewer reports FAIL.
